_about: Data for flow_graph/check_doc_style.py, the light check of docs-authority/DOC_STYLE.md (AQS-DOC-002). banned: working jargon that a reader outside the project cannot follow, each with why it is banned and what to write instead (patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against prose, with code removed). not_abbreviations: words written in capitals that are not abbreviations, such as signal words. long_abbreviations: abbreviations of six or more letters (longer capitalised tokens are otherwise read as words set in capitals). agent_only: paths that hold agent instructions and are not published pages. exempt: pages skipped by the check, each with its reason. pending: published pages not yet rewritten to the guide. Their findings do not fail the check. A page is removed by hand only after a genuine rewrite, not because it happens to pass; no page may be added.

banned.why: the working machine used to produce a file
banned.instead: name the tool and version, or say nothing

banned.why: a working machine, not a reader's reference

banned.instead: say which pages need which change

banned.why: a batch of work in a task list
banned.instead: give the date, revision or task id

banned.why: chat slang for committed or delivered
banned.instead: say what was added and where
say what is or is not available and why

banned.why: an instruction addressed to an assistant
banned.instead: name the role: the reader, the operator, the owner
name the task or work group
state the decision and its reason (OPEN_QUESTIONS.md)

exempt.reason: The style guide quotes the banned terms as examples.
The Contributor Covenant text is adopted unchanged.
